Number of retained older/newer element-set residual pairs from this
object in the age bin containing AGE_DAYS, after rejection/clipping.
Zero means no retained pairs; never the held-out test count SAMPLES.

HISTORY_SETS.description:
Number of distinct older element sets contributing HISTORY_SAMPLES.
Zero means none; never the distinct calibration-object count OBJECTS.

HISTORY_WINDOW.description:
ISO 8601 UTC start/end interval spanning the element-set epochs used
in the object's history fit. Empty when no history was used. This is
training support, not TEST_WINDOW or the element-set age AGE_DAYS.

SHRINKAGE_WEIGHT.description:
Dimensionless population-prior fraction alpha in the covariance blend
P = (1-alpha) H + alpha P_prior, where H is the history error second
moment and P_prior includes the population model's realism scaling.
Range [0,1]: 0 is all history, 1 is all prior; NaN when not applicable
or unknown. For interpolation across bins, report the correspondingly
interpolated alpha. EVIDENCE must identify the estimator/configuration,
retained-count bin, participating bins and their weights so the blend
can be reconstructed; the scalar alone does not describe that mixture.
This is not SCALE_FACTOR, which multiplies a covariance. History-only
evidence leaves CALIBRATION Uncalibrated and test statistics unmeasured.

CENTER_NAME.description:
Center Name (e.g. EARTH, MARS). A set about another body names it: MOON,
SUN or a planet.

REFERENCE_FRAME.description:
Reference Frame
Typically TEMEOFDATE
The Earth-Moon synodic (rotating) frame of a libration-point orbit is the
RFMCoordinateSystem with AXIS_TYPE OBJECT_REFERENCED: OBJECT_REFERENCED_AXES
names the Earth as PRIMARY_OBJECT_ID and the Moon as SECONDARY_OBJECT_ID
(ephemeris body codes 399 and 301, as text), X_AXIS RADIAL and Z_AXIS
ORBIT_NORMAL, Y completing the triad; ORIGIN is the Moon (CELESTIAL_BODY),
the Earth-Moon barycenter (BARYCENTRE) or the libration point
(LIBRATION_POINT with its primary and secondary). No other frame value is
needed for it.

COMMENT.description:
COMMENT (O): every COMMENT line of the message, in message order, joined by
a line feed. A message states comments in its header, its metadata and each
data group; this field holds them all, so a message written from the record
states them together in its header.

EPOCH.description: EPOCH of Mean Keplerian elements (ISO 8601 UTC format)

SEMI_MAJOR_AXIS.description: Semi-major axis in km or Mean Motion in rev/day

MEAN_MOTION.description: Mean motion in rev/day if MEAN_ELEMENT_THEORY=SGP/SGP4 else unused

EPHEMERIS_TYPE.description:
TLE Related Parameters (Only if MEAN_ELEMENT_THEORY=SGP/SGP4)
EPHEMERIS_TYPE Default=0

BSTAR.description: BSTAR in 1/Earth radii, or BTERM in m**2/kg for SGP4-XP [C]

MEAN_MOTION_DOT.description: MEAN_MOTION_DOT in rev/day**2 [C if SGP or PPT3]

MEAN_MOTION_DDOT.description: MEAN_MOTION_DDOT in rev/day**3 if SGP/PPT3 or AGOM in m**2/kg if SGP4-XP [C]

COV_REFERENCE_FRAME.description:
Position/Velocity Covariance Matrix (6x6 Lower Triangular) [C if any covariance provided]
COV_REF_FRAME reference frame for covariance [C if covariance given]
Typically RSW

COVARIANCE.description:
Covariance matrix as flat array (6x6 lower triangular = 21 elements).
Order: [CX_X, CY_X, CY_Y, CZ_X, CZ_Y, CZ_Z,
CX_DOT_X, CX_DOT_Y, CX_DOT_Z, CX_DOT_X_DOT,
CY_DOT_X, CY_DOT_Y, CY_DOT_Z, CY_DOT_X_DOT, CY_DOT_Y_DOT,
CZ_DOT_X, CZ_DOT_Y, CZ_DOT_Z, CZ_DOT_X_DOT, CZ_DOT_Y_DOT, CZ_DOT_Z_DOT]
Units: position in km**2, velocity in km**2/s**2, cross in km**2/s

CLASSIFICATION.description:
CLASSIFICATION of the message: the optional CCSDS 502.0-B-3 header keyword
that states its security classification or handling caveat. Not
CLASSIFICATION_TYPE, which is the TLE element set's U, C or S.

MESSAGE_ID.description:
MESSAGE_ID: the optional CCSDS 502.0-B-3 header keyword, an identifier the
originator makes unique for this message.

USER_DEFINED_PARAMETERS.description:
Every USER_DEFINED_x keyword (KVN) or USER_DEFINED element (NDM/XML) of the
message that has no dedicated field above, in message order.

PROVENANCE.description: Where the element set comes from and the terms it travels under.

OMMUserDefinedParameter.description:
One USER_DEFINED_x keyword of an OMM, or one USER_DEFINED element of its XML
form: the parameter name (the x) and the value as written.

PARAM_NAME.description: x, the part of the keyword after USER_DEFINED_ (the XML parameter attribute)

PARAM_VALUE.description: The value as written, unit-less text

ephemerisDataLine.description:
A single ephemeris data line (for non-uniform time steps only)
Use this format when time intervals between states are irregular.
For uniform time steps, use the compact EPHEMERIS_DATA array instead.

EPOCH.description: Epoch time, in ISO 8601 UTC format (required for non-uniform steps)

CLOCK_BIAS_MICROSECONDS.description:
Satellite clock bias (offset), microseconds. SP3 position-record clock
column. The SP3 bad/absent sentinel 999999.999999 is NOT stored; omit the
field instead.

CLOCK_RATE_MICROSECONDS_PER_SECOND.description:
Satellite clock rate of change, 1e-4 microseconds per second. SP3
velocity-record clock-rate column. Sentinel 999999.999999 is not stored.

CLOCK_RATE_SIGMA_PICOSECONDS_PER_SECOND.description:
Standard deviation of CLOCK_RATE_MICROSECONDS_PER_SECOND,
1e-4 picoseconds per second.

X_SIGMA_EXPONENT.description:
Per-coordinate position standard-deviation EXPONENTS, SP3 base**n form:
sigma = POS_VEL_BASE**n, with the position base from the SP3 header and
the result in mm. These are the raw SP3 exponent columns, kept as
exponents so an SP3 round-trip is exact; a consumer that wants a linear
sigma raises the header base to this power.

X_DOT_SIGMA_EXPONENT.description:
Per-coordinate velocity standard-deviation exponents, result in
1e-4 mm/s. Same base**n rule.

COMMENT.description: COMMENT lines of this covariance matrix (CCSDS 502.0-B-3), joined by a line feed.

COV_REFERENCE_FRAME.description:
COV_REF_FRAME of this matrix (CCSDS 502.0-B-3): the frame the matrix
is expressed in, when it differs from the block's COV_REFERENCE_FRAME.

OBJECT.description: Satellite name for the first object

CENTER_NAME.description: Origin of reference frame (EARTH, MARS, MOON, etc.)

REFERENCE_FRAME.description: Name of the reference frame (TEME, EME2000, etc.)

REFERENCE_FRAME_EPOCH.description: Epoch of reference frame, if not intrinsic to the definition of the reference frame

COV_REFERENCE_FRAME.description: Reference frame for the covariance matrix

TIME_SYSTEM.description: Time system used for the orbit state and covariance matrix. (UTC)

START_TIME.description: Start of TOTAL time span covered by ephemeris data and covariance data (ISO 8601)

USEABLE_START_TIME.description: Optional start USEABLE time span covered by ephemeris data (ISO 8601)

USEABLE_STOP_TIME.description: Optional end of USEABLE time span covered by ephemeris data (ISO 8601)

STOP_TIME.description: End of TOTAL time span covered by ephemeris data and covariance data (ISO 8601)

INTERPOLATION.description:
Recommended interpolation method for ephemeris data.
Supported methods: Hermite, Linear, Lagrange, Chebyshev.
When set to "Chebyshev", parsers should use POLYNOMIAL_POSITION_RECORDS
for high-fidelity polynomial interpolation instead of interpolating across
discrete state vectors.

INTERPOLATION_DEGREE.description: Recommended interpolation degree for ephemeris data

STEP_SIZE.description:
Time interval between ephemeris states in seconds.
If > 0: Use compact EPHEMERIS_DATA array (times are implicit).
If 0 or omitted: Use EPHEMERIS_DATA_LINES with explicit epochs.

STATE_VECTOR_SIZE.description:
Number of components per state vector in EPHEMERIS_DATA array.
6 = position + velocity (X, Y, Z, X_DOT, Y_DOT, Z_DOT)
9 = position + velocity + acceleration (adds X_DDOT, Y_DDOT, Z_DDOT)
Only used when STEP_SIZE > 0. Default is 6.

EPHEMERIS_DATA.description:
Compact ephemeris data as row-major array of doubles.
Only used when STEP_SIZE > 0.
Layout: [x0,y0,z0,xdot0,ydot0,zdot0, x1,y1,z1,xdot1,ydot1,zdot1, ...]
Units: position in km, velocity in km/s, acceleration in km/s²
Length must be divisible by STATE_VECTOR_SIZE.
Number of states = length(EPHEMERIS_DATA) / STATE_VECTOR_SIZE

EPHEMERIS_DATA_LINES.description:
Array of ephemeris data lines with explicit epochs.
Only used when STEP_SIZE == 0 or omitted (non-uniform time steps).
Each line contains its own EPOCH timestamp.

POLYNOMIAL_POSITION_RECORDS.description:
Optional polynomial position records for high-fidelity interpolation.
Used when INTERPOLATION is "Chebyshev". Each record covers a time segment with
polynomial coefficients for continuous position (and optionally velocity) evaluation.
See PPE schema for record structure and evaluation procedure.

OBJECT_NAIF_ID.description: NAIF integer code of the ephemeris target (SPK segment target).

CENTER_NAIF_ID.description:
NAIF integer code of the ephemeris centre, matching CENTER_NAME
(SPK segment centre).

CLASSIFICATION.description:
OEM Header
Classification marking of the data in IC/CAPCO Portion-marked format.

COMMENT.description: COMMENT lines of the OEM header (CCSDS 502.0-B-3), joined by a line feed.

MESSAGE_ID.description:
MESSAGE_ID of the OEM header (CCSDS 502.0-B-3): an identifier the originator
makes unique for this message.

YEAR.description: Four-digit year identifying the model version (e.g., 1970, 2008, 2020)

CCSDS_OCM_VERS.description: Format version in the form of 'x.y', where 'y' is incremented for minor changes, and 'x' for major changes.

COMMENT.description: Comments (a contiguous set of one or more comment lines may be provided immediately after the version number).

CLASSIFICATION.description: User-defined free-text message classification/caveats of this OCM.

MESSAGE_ID.description: Free-text field containing an ID that uniquely identifies a message from this originator.

OBJECT_NAME.description: Free-text field containing the name of the object.

INTERNATIONAL_DESIGNATOR.description: International designator for the object as assigned by COSPAR.

CATALOG_NAME.description: Satellite catalog source from which 'OBJECT_DESIGNATOR' was obtained.

OBJECT_DESIGNATOR.description: Unique satellite identification designator from the catalog.

ALTERNATE_NAMES.description: Alternate names of this space object.

ORIGINATOR_POC.description: Originator or programmatic Point-of-Contact (PoC) for OCM.

ORIGINATOR_POSITION.description: Contact position of the originator PoC.

TECH_ORG.description: Creating agency or operator for technical contact.

TECH_POSITION.description: Contact position of the technical PoC.

PREVIOUS_MESSAGE_ID.description: ID that uniquely identifies the previous message from this originator.

NEXT_MESSAGE_ID.description: ID that uniquely identifies the next message from this originator.

ADM_MSG_LINK.description: Unique identifier of Attitude Data Messages linked to this OCM.

CDM_MSG_LINK.description: Unique identifier of Conjunction Data Messages linked to this OCM.

PRM_MSG_LINK.description: Unique identifier of Pointing Request Messages linked to this OCM.

RDM_MSG_LINK.description: Unique identifier of Reentry Data Messages linked to this OCM.

TDM_MSG_LINK.description: List of Tracking Data Messages upon which this orbit determination is based.

COUNTRY.description: Country where the space object owner is based.

CONSTELLATION.description: Name of the constellation to which this space object belongs.

OBJECT_TYPE.description: Specification of the type of object (e.g., PAYLOAD, ROCKET BODY, DEBRIS).

TIME_SYSTEM.description: Time system for all absolute time stamps in this OCM, including EPOCH_TZERO.

EPOCH_TZERO.description: Default epoch to which all relative times are referenced in data blocks.

OPS_STATUS.description: Specification of the operational status of the space object.

ORBIT_CATEGORY.description: Specification of the type of orbit (e.g., GEO, LEO).

OCM_DATA_ELEMENTS.description: List of elements of information data blocks included in this message.

SCLK_OFFSET_AT_EPOCH.description: Number of spacecraft clock counts at EPOCH_TZERO (used if TIME_SYSTEM is SCLK).

SCLK_SEC_PER_SI_SEC.description: Number of clock seconds occurring during one SI second (used if TIME_SYSTEM is SCLK).

PREVIOUS_MESSAGE_EPOCH.description: Creation epoch of the previous message from this originator.

NEXT_MESSAGE_EPOCH.description: Anticipated (or actual) epoch of the next message from this originator.

START_TIME.description: Time of the earliest data contained in the OCM.

STOP_TIME.description: Time of the latest data contained in the OCM.

TIME_SPAN.description: Span of time that the OCM covers, measured in days.

TAIMUTC_AT_TZERO.description: Difference (TAI - UTC) in seconds at EPOCH_TZERO.

NEXT_LEAP_TAIMUTC.description: Difference (TAI - UTC) in seconds at NEXT_LEAP_EPOCH.

UT1MUTC_AT_TZERO.description: Difference (UT1 - UTC) in seconds at EPOCH_TZERO.

EOP_SOURCE.description: Source and version of Earth Orientation Parameters used.

INTERP_METHOD_EOP.description: Method used to select or interpolate sequential EOP data.

CELESTIAL_SOURCE.description: Source and version of celestial body ephemeris data used.

X.description: X component of position in the specified reference frame.

COMMENT.description: Comments in the Physical Properties section.

WET_MASS.description: Wet mass of the space object.

DRY_MASS.description: Dry mass of the space object.

OEB_Q1.description: Quaternion component q1 of orientation from OEB to EME2000.

OEB_MAX.description: Maximum dimension of the object along OEB frame axes.

OEB_INT.description: Intermediate dimension along OEB frame axes.

OEB_MIN.description: Minimum dimension of the object along OEB frame axes.

SRP_CONST_AREA.description: Constant area for solar radiation pressure computations.

SRP_UNCERTAINTY.description: Uncertainty in the solar radiation pressure coefficient.

DOCKED_WITH.description: DOCKED_WITH: comma-separated names of the objects it is docked with.

INITIAL_WET_MASS.description: INITIAL_WET_MASS in kg, NaN when not stated.

OEB_PARENT_FRAME.description: OEB_PARENT_FRAME: the frame the optimally enclosing box is defined in.

AREA_MIN_FOR_PC.description: AREA_MIN_FOR_PC in m**2, NaN when not stated.

AREA_MAX_FOR_PC.description: AREA_MAX_FOR_PC in m**2, NaN when not stated.

AREA_TYP_FOR_PC.description: AREA_TYP_FOR_PC in m**2, NaN when not stated.

RCS.description: RCS in m**2, NaN when not stated.

RCS_MIN.description: RCS_MIN in m**2, NaN when not stated.

RCS_MAX.description: RCS_MAX in m**2, NaN when not stated.

VM_ABSOLUTE.description: VM_ABSOLUTE: absolute visual magnitude, NaN when not stated.

VM_APPARENT_MIN.description: VM_APPARENT_MIN: minimum apparent visual magnitude, NaN when not stated.

VM_APPARENT.description: VM_APPARENT: apparent visual magnitude, NaN when not stated.

VM_APPARENT_MAX.description: VM_APPARENT_MAX: maximum apparent visual magnitude, NaN when not stated.

REFLECTANCE.description: REFLECTANCE: typical reflectivity, NaN when not stated.

ATT_KNOWLEDGE.description: ATT_KNOWLEDGE in degrees, NaN when not stated.

ATT_CONTROL.description: ATT_CONTROL in degrees, NaN when not stated.

ATT_POINTING.description: ATT_POINTING in degrees, NaN when not stated.

AVG_MANEUVER_FREQ.description: AVG_MANEUVER_FREQ in maneuvers per year, NaN when not stated.

MAX_THRUST.description: MAX_THRUST in N, NaN when not stated.

DV_BOL.description: DV_BOL: delta-v at beginning of life in km/s, NaN when not stated.

DV_REMAINING.description: DV_REMAINING in km/s, NaN when not stated.

IXX.description: IXX in kg*m**2, NaN when not stated.

IYY.description: IYY in kg*m**2, NaN when not stated.

IZZ.description: IZZ in kg*m**2, NaN when not stated.

IXY.description: IXY in kg*m**2, NaN when not stated.

IXZ.description: IXZ in kg*m**2, NaN when not stated.

IYZ.description: IYZ in kg*m**2, NaN when not stated.

GM.description: Gravitational constant times the mass of the central body.

N_BODY_PERTURBATIONS.description: List of celestial bodies included in n-body perturbations.

FIXED_F10P7.description: Fixed F10.7 solar flux value used.

FIXED_F10P7_MEAN.description: Fixed mean F10.7 solar flux value used.

FIXED_GEOMAG_AP.description:
Fixed (time-invariant) geomagnetic index ap used in place of the normal
time-varying values (CCSDS 502.0-B-3 FIXED_GEOMAG_AP).

ATMOSPHERIC_MODEL_NAME.description:
ATMOSPHERIC_MODEL as the message wrote it (CCSDS 502.0-B-3); ATMOSPHERIC_MODEL
above is the model family when the text names one.

EQUATORIAL_RADIUS.description: EQUATORIAL_RADIUS in km, NaN when not stated.

CENTRAL_BODY_ROTATION.description: CENTRAL_BODY_ROTATION in deg/s, NaN when not stated.

SW_DATA_SOURCE.description: SW_DATA_SOURCE: the space weather data source.

FIXED_GEOMAG_DST.description: FIXED_GEOMAG_DST in nT, NaN when not stated.

MAN_BASIS.description: Basis of the maneuver plan (e.g., planned, predicted, estimated).

MAN_REF_FRAME.description: Reference frame for the maneuver data.

MAN_FRAME_EPOCH.description: Epoch of the maneuver reference frame.

MAN_UNITS.description: Units for the maneuver data values.

MAN_COMPOSITION.description:
Ordered DATA columns, including TIME_ABSOLUTE or TIME_RELATIVE first.
CCSDS 502.0-B-3 Tables 6-7 to 6-9; absent means composition unspecified.
DATA entries are complete time-history lines; MAN_UNITS excludes time tags.
Relative time tags are seconds from METADATA.EPOCH_TZERO.

MAN_BASIS_ID.description: OD, navigation solution or simulation identifier (Table 6-7).

MAN_PREV_EPOCH.description:
Previous maneuver completion: absolute epoch or seconds from EPOCH_TZERO.
CCSDS 502.0-B-3 Table 6-7; absolute times use METADATA.TIME_SYSTEM.

MAN_NEXT_EPOCH.description: Next maneuver start; same time convention as MAN_PREV_EPOCH (Table 6-7).

MAN_PRED_SOURCE.description: Source of predicted orbit or attitude states (Table 6-7).

DC_TYPE.description: CONTINUOUS, TIME or TIME_AND_ANGLE; absent means CONTINUOUS (Table 6-7).

DC_WIN_OPEN.description: Duty-cycle window start; MAN_PREV_EPOCH time convention (Table 6-7).

DC_WIN_CLOSE.description: Duty-cycle window end; MAN_PREV_EPOCH time convention (Table 6-7).

DC_MIN_CYCLES.description: Minimum and maximum ON cycles; HAS_DC_*_CYCLES marks presence (Table 6-7).

HAS_DC_MIN_CYCLES.description: Presence of the corresponding cycle bound; zero remains representable.

DC_EXEC_START.description:
First and final duty-cycle sequence times; MAN_PREV_EPOCH convention.
Required with DC_WIN_OPEN/CLOSE when DC_TYPE is not CONTINUOUS (Table 6-7).

DC_REF_TIME.description: Duty-cycle reference time; MAN_PREV_EPOCH time convention (Table 6-7).

DC_TIME_PULSE_DURATION.description:
Pulse ON duration and start-to-start period, seconds; NaN means absent (Table 6-7).
Required with DC_REF_TIME for non-continuous cycles; period >= duration.

DC_REF_DIR.description:
Three-component reference unit direction in MAN_REF_FRAME (Table 6-7).
Required with DC_BODY_FRAME/TRIGGER and both angles for TIME_AND_ANGLE.

DC_PA_START_ANGLE.description:
Pulse start and stop phase angles, degrees; NaN means unspecified.
CCSDS 502.0-B-3 Table 6-7.

OCMDynamicParameter.description:
A parameter of the dynamical model that an orbit solution carries with the state: its value at the solution
epoch and whether the orbit determination solved for it (a held value is a catalog value).

NAME.description:
Parameter name. A VCM's B, BDOT, AGOM and T are DRAG_AREA_OVER_MASS (Cd*A/m), DRAG_AREA_OVER_MASS_RATE,
SRP_AREA_OVER_MASS (Cr*A/m) and IN_TRACK_ACCELERATION, the names of PRW's prwDynamicParameter. Other names
are the producer's, as in USER_DEFINED_PARAMETERS.

VALUE.description: Value at the solution epoch, in UNITS.

UNITS.description:
Units of VALUE: m**2/kg for DRAG_AREA_OVER_MASS and SRP_AREA_OVER_MASS, m**2/kg/s for DRAG_AREA_OVER_MASS_RATE,
m/s**2 for IN_TRACK_ACCELERATION.

SOLVED_FOR.description: True when the orbit determination solved for the parameter, false when VALUE was held.

OD_ID.description: Unique identifier for the orbit determination.

OD_PREV_ID.description: Identifier of the previous orbit determination.

OD_TIME_TAG.description: Time tag of the orbit determination.

OD_OBSERVATIONS_TYPE.description: Types of observations used (e.g., RANGE, DOPPLER).

OD_APRIORI_DATA.description: A priori data used for orbit determination.

OD_ESTIMATOR.description: Estimator class provenance: batch fit vs sequential filter (EKF/UKF).

OD_RESIDUAL_RMS.description: RMS of post-fit residuals for this solution.

OD_RESIDUALS_SERIES.description: Post-fit residual series, one entry per accepted observation.

OD_RESIDUAL_EPOCHS.description:
Epochs aligned with OD_RESIDUALS_SERIES (UNIX timestamp) [numeric seconds
since 1970-01-01T00:00:00 UTC].

OD_BATCH_BASELINE_ID.description:
OD_ID of the batch baseline solution a filtered solution derives from and
is compared against (empty for batch solutions).

OD_BATCH_BASELINE_RMS.description:
Post-fit residual RMS of the batch baseline, for direct batch-vs-filter
comparison.

SEDR.description:
Specific energy dissipation rate in W/kg: energy removed from the orbit
by non-conservative forces, averaged during the OD (CCSDS 502.0-B-3 SEDR).

WEIGHTED_RMS.description: Weighted RMS residual ratio of a batch OD (CCSDS 502.0-B-3 WEIGHTED_RMS).

OD_DYNAMIC_PARAMETERS.description:
Dynamical-model parameters of the solution with their values, solved for or held. An
IN_TRACK_ACCELERATION entry means the empirical in-track thrust is part of the force model. The rows
COV_PARAMETERS names in the covariance are entries of this list.

RECOMMENDED_OD_SPAN.description: RECOMMENDED_OD_SPAN in days, NaN when not stated.

ACTUAL_OD_SPAN.description: ACTUAL_OD_SPAN in days, NaN when not stated.

MAXIMUM_OBS_GAP.description: MAXIMUM_OBS_GAP in days, NaN when not stated.

OD_EPOCH_EIGMAJ.description: OD_EPOCH_EIGMAJ in m, NaN when not stated.

OD_EPOCH_EIGINT.description: OD_EPOCH_EIGINT in m, NaN when not stated.

OD_EPOCH_EIGMIN.description: OD_EPOCH_EIGMIN in m, NaN when not stated.

OD_MAX_PRED_EIGMAJ.description: OD_MAX_PRED_EIGMAJ in m, NaN when not stated.

OD_MIN_PRED_EIGMIN.description: OD_MIN_PRED_EIGMIN in m, NaN when not stated.

OD_CONFIDENCE.description: OD_CONFIDENCE in percent, NaN when not stated.

SOLVE_N.description: SOLVE_N: the number of solved-for states.

SOLVE_STATES.description: SOLVE_STATES: the solved-for states, as written.

CONSIDER_N.description: CONSIDER_N: the number of consider parameters.

CONSIDER_PARAMS.description: CONSIDER_PARAMS: the consider parameters, as written.

COMMENT.description: COMMENT lines of the orbit determination block (CCSDS 502.0-B-3), one entry per line.

OCMTrajectoryBlock.description:
One trajectory state time history of an OCM (CCSDS 502.0-B-3 Table 6-3 .. 6-4):
the block's keywords, and its data lines as written (a time tag, then the
numbers TRAJ_TYPE says). The single-trajectory fields of the OCM above state
the first block's CARTPV or CARTPVA states for the modules that read those.

COMMENT.description: COMMENT lines of this block, joined by a line feed.

TRAJ_BASIS.description: TRAJ_BASIS: PREDICTED, DETERMINED, TELEMETRY, SIMULATED or OTHER.

TRAJ_TYPE.description: TRAJ_TYPE as written, for example CARTPV.

OCMCovarianceBlock.description:
One covariance time history of an OCM (Table 6-6): the block's keywords and its
data lines as written (a time tag, then the covariance in COV_ORDERING). The
single-covariance fields of the OCM above state the first block when it is one
line.

COMMENT.description: COMMENT lines of this block, joined by a line feed.

COV_BASIS.description: COV_BASIS: PREDICTED, DETERMINED, EMPIRICAL, SIMULATED or OTHER.

COV_CONFIDENCE.description: COV_CONFIDENCE in percent, NaN when not stated.

COV_TYPE.description: COV_TYPE as written, for example CARTPV.

COV_REALISM.description:
Realism of the block's covariance: one entry per line of LINES, in order,
or one entry for every line.

TRAJ_TYPE.description:
Trajectory state representation type.
Determines how orbit state data is parameterized in this message.
For CARTESIAN_PV/CARTESIAN_PVA, use STATE_DATA array.
For POLYNOMIAL_POS/POLYNOMIAL_OE, use the corresponding polynomial record arrays.

TRAJ_TYPE_DESCRIPTION.description:
Legacy trajectory type string for backward compatibility and extended types
(e.g., "PROPAGATED", "ESTIMATED", "FILTERED").

STATE_STEP_SIZE.description: Time interval between state vectors in seconds; required without STATE_EPOCHS.

STATE_VECTOR_SIZE.description:
Number of components per state vector.
6 = position + velocity (X, Y, Z, X_DOT, Y_DOT, Z_DOT)
9 = position + velocity + acceleration (adds X_DDOT, Y_DDOT, Z_DDOT)
6 or 7 for the element sets named by TRAJ_TYPE.

STATE_DATA.description:
State data as row-major array of doubles.
Layout: [X0, Y0, Z0, X_DOT0, Y_DOT0, Z_DOT0, X1, Y1, Z1, ...]
Time reconstruction uses STATE_EPOCHS when present, otherwise START_TIME + i * STATE_STEP_SIZE.
Length must be divisible by STATE_VECTOR_SIZE.
Units: km, km/s and km/s**2, in TRAJ_REF_FRAME about CENTER_NAME.

COVARIANCE_DATA.description:
Covariance data as a flat array, one N x N matrix per epoch, N = COV_SIZE, aligned with the STATE_DATA epochs.
COV_ORDERING gives the values per epoch: N(N+1)/2 for LTM and UTM, N*N for FULL, LTMWCC and UTMWCC. Entry [i,j]
has the product of the units of state elements i and j (km**2, km**2/s, km**2/s**2 for a position-velocity
state), and of COV_UNITS for the parameter rows. Without COV_TYPE, COV_ORDERING and COV_SIZE: 21 elements per
epoch, the lower triangle of the 6x6 position and velocity covariance.

POLYNOMIAL_POSITION_RECORDS.description:
Polynomial position records.
Used when TRAJ_TYPE is POLYNOMIAL_POS. Each record covers a time segment
with polynomial coefficients for X, Y, Z position (and optionally velocity).
See PPE schema for record structure and evaluation procedure.

POLYNOMIAL_OE_RECORDS.description:
Polynomial orbital element records.
Used when TRAJ_TYPE is POLYNOMIAL_OE. Each record covers a time segment
with polynomial coefficients for classical orbital elements.
See PPE schema for record structure and evaluation procedure.

PHYSICAL_PROPERTIES.description: Physical properties of the space object.

TRAJ_REF_FRAME.description:
Reference frame of STATE_DATA and the polynomial records
(CCSDS 502.0-B-3 TRAJ_REF_FRAME).

TRAJ_FRAME_EPOCH.description:
Epoch of TRAJ_REF_FRAME when it is not intrinsic to the frame
(CCSDS 502.0-B-3 TRAJ_FRAME_EPOCH).

ORB_REVNUM.description: Orbit revolution number at the first state (CCSDS 502.0-B-3 ORB_REVNUM).

ORB_AVERAGING.description:
For element sets: OSCULATING, or the mean-element theory used (BROUWER,
KOZAI, ...) (CCSDS 502.0-B-3 ORB_AVERAGING). Absent means OSCULATING.

COV_CALIBRATION.description:
Whether COVARIANCE_DATA's coverage was measured against independent
reference states: Calibrated only when every COV_REALISM entry is.

COV_CALIBRATION_REFERENCE.description: Identifier of that calibration evidence (a report or record).

STATE_EPOCHS.description:
Absolute epoch per STATE_DATA row in METADATA.TIME_SYSTEM (CCSDS 502.0-B-3
section 6.2.4). When nonempty, length equals STATE_DATA.length /
STATE_VECTOR_SIZE and these epochs override START_TIME + i * STATE_STEP_SIZE.
Absent or empty retains the uniform grid; COVARIANCE_DATA shares these epochs.

COV_TYPE.description:
Element set of the state block of COVARIANCE_DATA (CCSDS 502.0-B-3 COV_TYPE): a SANA orbital element set
(CARTP, CARTPV, CARTPVA, ADBARV, KEPLERIAN, EQUINOCTIAL ...) or a covariance representation (SIG3EIGVEC3 and
TSIG3EIGVEC3 give 13 and 14 values per epoch whatever COV_SIZE says). Absent means CARTPV.

COV_ORDERING.description: Order of the covariance values at each epoch (CCSDS 502.0-B-3 COV_ORDERING).

COV_SIZE.description:
Dimension N of the covariance matrix at each epoch: the rows of the state block (6 for CARTPV) plus the rows
COV_PARAMETERS names.

COV_PARAMETERS.description:
Names of the covariance rows after the state block, in order: dynamical-model parameters carried with the state,
by their names in ORBIT_DETERMINATION.OD_DYNAMIC_PARAMETERS (a VCM's B, BDOT, AGOM, T in that order, as far as its
matrix reaches). A row the orbit determination did not solve for is zero.

COV_UNITS.description:
Units of the standard deviation of each diagonal element, N entries (CCSDS 502.0-B-3 COV_UNITS), "n/a" for a
dimensionless one.

TRAJECTORY_BLOCKS.description:
Every trajectory state time history of the message (CCSDS 502.0-B-3 TRAJ_START
blocks), in message order. TRAJ_TYPE, STATE_DATA and the fields that go with
them above state the first block's CARTPV or CARTPVA states.

COVARIANCE_BLOCKS.description:
Every covariance time history of the message (COV_START blocks), in message
order. COVARIANCE_DATA and the fields that go with it above state the first
block when it is one line.

PROVENANCE.description: Where the message's data comes from and the terms it travels under.

COV_REALISM.description:
Realism of COVARIANCE_DATA: one entry per epoch, in the order of the
STATE_DATA epochs, or one entry for every epoch.

PNM.description:
Publish Notification Message.

PNM is the compact network announcement for a published record, manifest, or
dataset update. For dataset updates, FILE_ID is the complete canonical
identity for the published update and CID usually points to a small DPM
manifest or digest. The DPM carries the full verification contract:
provider identity, retrieval protocol, canonical query, result hash, Merkle
roots, completeness-capable indexes, file_id partition key, and signature.
Large or paid dataset updates do not need to be published as globally
discoverable IPFS files; a PNM may instead advertise a provider-mediated SDN
query protocol. In that mode the PNM is only the announcement. The DPM is
the signed commitment, and each provider response carries records plus
Merkle proof material that the subscriber verifies against the DPM roots and
the announced FILE_ID before import.

MULTIFORMAT_ADDRESS.description:
Multiformat Address
As specified by the multiaddr specification.
A universal address format for representing multiple network protocols. Examples include:
- /ip4/192.168.1.1/tcp/80 for an IPv4 address with TCP protocol
- /ip6zone/x/ip6/::1 for an IPv6 address with a zone
- /dns4/example.com for a domain name resolvable only to IPv4 addresses
- /ipfs/bafybeiccfclkdtucu6y4yc5cpr6y3yuinr67svmii46v5cfcrkp47ihehy/README.txt -IPFS address w/CID and path to `README.txt`.

PUBLISH_TIMESTAMP.description: Publish Time OF THE Publish Notification Message

CID.description:
Concatenated Content Identifier (CID)
This field is a unique ID for distributed systems (CID).
The CID provides a unique identifier within distributed systems, as
detailed in the multiformats CID specification.
For dataset-update PNMs this SHOULD identify a compact DPM manifest,
manifest digest, or other small verification object, not necessarily the
full dataset bytes.

FILE_NAME.description:
File ID
This field is the Name

FILE_ID.description:
File ID
Canonical publication/update partition identity. For dataset-update PNMs,
this MUST match DPM.FILE_ID and is the stable key used everywhere an SDN
component refers to the update: PNMs, DPMs, assets, entitlements, provider
query requests, subscriber caches, replay, audit, and completeness
verification. Provider-mediated query requests and responses MUST bind
their Merkle leaves and proof paths to this FILE_ID, and subscribers MUST
reject responses whose DPM, records, or proofs bind to a different FILE_ID.
Example: provider-slug:gp:OMM.fbs:2026-05-06T03:00:00Z.

SIGNATURE.description:
Digital Signature of the CID
This is the digital signature of the CID, signed using the specified cryptographic method.

TIMESTAMP_SIGNATURE.description:
Timestamp Signature
Digital signature of the publish timestamp, using the specified cryptographic method for timestamp verification.

SIGNATURE_TYPE.description:
Type of Cryptographic Signature Used
Specifies the type of cryptographic signature used for the SIGNATURE field, indicating the specific blockchain technology, such as Ethereum or BTC.

TIMESTAMP_SIGNATURE_TYPE.description:
Type of Cryptographic Signature Used for Timestamp
Specifies the type of cryptographic signature used for the TIMESTAMP_SIGNATURE field, indicating the specific blockchain technology, such as Ethereum or BTC.

CryptoKey.description:
Represents cryptographic key information.

The publication paradigm is "literal public keys, not derivation
material": a published EPM carries the PUBLIC_KEY bytes that verify
the record's SIGNATURE (signing) or encrypt to the entity (encryption),
and NOTHING about how those keys were derived. XPUB, KEY_PATH and
KEY_ADDRESS are PRIVATE / operational — they belong to the wallet that
produced the keys, never to the record a peer resolves.

Requiredness is PROFILE-ENFORCED, never a flatc `(required)` attribute:
a `(required)` on PUBLIC_KEY would make the flatbuffers Verifier reject
every pre-flip secp256k1 record that legitimately omitted it (the
2026-07-27 dual-curve regime allowed xpub-derivation for secp at
non-hardened paths). A published record is self-describing instead —
PUBLIC_KEY present, XPUB/KEY_PATH/KEY_ADDRESS absent — and a conformance
checker asserts that profile (see scripts/check-epm-published-profile.mjs).

Rotation is by republish: a new signing or encryption key means a new
PUBLIC_KEY, a re-signed SIGNATURE, and a re-published EPM at the same
peer-addressed location. The PeerID (multihash of the libp2p identity
pubkey) is the stable anchor across rotations.

PUBLIC_KEY.description:
Public part of the cryptographic key, in hexadecimal format. AUTHORITATIVE
in a published record: this is the verifying/encrypting key, and no other
field yields it. Required-in-practice (profile-enforced, not flatc
`(required)`) so that pre-flip secp256k1 records without it still decode.

XPUB.description:
Extended public key, as specified by BIP-32 (hierarchical deterministic
wallets), "Extended keys". PRIVATE / operational: present only in the
wallet that derived the keys, ABSENT from published records. A verifier
never derives a child key from XPUB — the PUBLIC_KEY is the verification
material.

PRIVATE_KEY.description: Private part of the cryptographic key in hexidecimal format, should be kept secret

XPRIV.description: Extended private key, as specified by BIP-32 (hierarchical deterministic wallets), "Extended keys".

KEY_ADDRESS.description:
Address generated from the cryptographic key. PRIVATE / operational in a
published EPM: a chain address is bound through a ChainProof attestation,
not carried as a standalone KEY_ADDRESS on the CryptoKey. ABSENT from
published records.

ADDRESS_TYPE.description:
Type of the address generated from the cryptographic key. An address
format tag only — NOT a curve or algorithm designator; the algorithm
lives in ALGORITHM

KEY_TYPE.description: Type of the cryptographic key (signing or encryption)

KEY_PATH.description:
BIP-32 / SLIP-10 derivation path of this key from the entity root
(e.g., "m/44'/0'/0'/0/0" secp256k1 non-hardened, "m/44'/0'/0'/0'/0'"
ed25519 hardened). PRIVATE / operational: how the key was derived belongs
to the wallet, not to a published record. ABSENT from published records.

ALGORITHM.description:
Key algorithm/curve (e.g., "ed25519", "secp256k1"). ABSENT means
ed25519: every record published before this field existed verifies
unchanged under that default. The verifier dispatches on ALGORITHM (not
on ADDRESS_TYPE, which is an address-format tag only).

ENCODING.description:
Signature encoding format produced by this key (e.g., "raw-ed25519",
"der"). ABSENT means the canonical encoding of ALGORITHM: raw-ed25519
for ed25519 (64 bytes over the content itself); der for secp256k1, a
strict DER ECDSA signature over ONE SHA-256 of the canonical signing
content (CANONICAL_SERIALIZATION.md section 4). The signer passes the
content to a hashing signer, or its single SHA-256 to a digest signer,
never a digest to a hashing signer: ECDSA over SHA-256(SHA-256(content))
does not verify. "compact" (65-byte header||r||s) is a ChainProof
encoding only, never the EPM signature's

REGION.description: Region of the address (e.g., state or province)

LOCALITY.description: Locality of the address (e.g., city or town)

ChainProof.description: Proves a blockchain key derives from the same HD wallet as the signing key

SIGNATURE.description:
Signature over the attestation payload (hex-encoded), in the chain's
own signed-message form (see ALGORITHM)

SIGNED_PAYLOAD.description: The canonical payload that was signed (hex-encoded)

ALGORITHM.description:
Signature algorithm, which fixes the one hash the signature is over:
"secp256k1-compact-bitcoin": the Bitcoin signed-message hash
SHA-256(SHA-256("\x18Bitcoin Signed Message:\n" || CompactSize(len)
|| SIGNED_PAYLOAD)), as Bitcoin Core's signmessage signs it (the
double SHA-256 is the protocol's own, applied once);
"secp256k1-compact-ethereum": the EIP-191 personal_sign hash
Keccak-256("\x19Ethereum Signed Message:\n" || decimal(len) ||
SIGNED_PAYLOAD), low-S;
"ed25519": raw Ed25519 over SIGNED_PAYLOAD itself.
Both secp256k1 forms are the 65-byte compact recoverable signature
header||r||s (header 27 + recovery id, +4 for a compressed key; signers
emit 31 + recovery id). A verifier hashes SIGNED_PAYLOAD with the chain's
protocol, recovers the key and compares it with PUBLIC_KEY (33-byte
compressed). Nothing hashes the payload before the protocol hash.

ENCODING.description:
Signature encoding format: "compact" for the secp256k1 algorithms
(65-byte header||r||s), "raw-ed25519" for ed25519

DomainProof.description:
Proves control of one or more DNS domains by the same HD wallet as the
signing key — the EPM-record mirror of the DNS TXT wire form (which is
deliberately NON-SDS: a base64 FlatBuffer would not fit a 255-byte TXT
record). The canonical statement is a fixed layout of LF-terminated lines,
versioned by its first line, that names every domain of DOMAINS, and it
verifies by BYTE-REPLAY of the verbatim SIGNED_PAYLOAD (ChainProof
precedent) — never by JCS.

DNS_DOMAIN.description:
Retired slot. Buffers written by SDS 1.265.0 (DNS_DOMAIN) and by 1.264.0
and earlier (DOMAIN) carry one domain string here. The slot is deprecated
in place — never retyped, renamed or reused — so those buffers still
decode; generated code has no accessor for it. Read DOMAINS.

KEY_PATH.description:
BIP-32 / SLIP-10 derivation path of the proving key. The signer is the
Ed25519 EPM/publication key at m/44'/0'/0'/0'/0'

SIGNED_PAYLOAD.description: The canonical payload that was signed, verbatim (hex-encoded)

ENCODING.description:
Signature encoding format. ABSENT means the canonical encoding of
ALGORITHM (raw-ed25519 for ed25519)

DOMAINS.description:
The fully-qualified domain names the proof binds, one or more, each
lowercase ASCII (internationalized names in punycode), e.g.
["node.example.org", "node.example.com"]. An empty vector is invalid.
SIGNED_PAYLOAD covers every name, in this order.

LEGAL_NAME.description: Common name of the entity (person or organization)

FAMILY_NAME.description: Family name or surname of the person

GIVEN_NAME.description: Given name or first name of the person

ADDITIONAL_NAME.description: Additional name or middle name of the person

HONORIFIC_PREFIX.description: Honorific prefix preceding the person's name (e.g., Mr., Dr.)

HONORIFIC_SUFFIX.description: Honorific suffix following the person's name (e.g., Jr., Sr.)

KEYS.description: Cryptographic keys associated with the entity

MULTIFORMAT_ADDRESS.description: Multiformat addresses associated with the entity

SIGNATURE.description:
Signature over canonical EPM content (hex), produced by the entity's
signing key under the algorithm declared in SIGNATURE_ALGORITHM
(absent declaration = Ed25519)

SIGNATURE_TIMESTAMP.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) when the EPM was signed

CHAIN_PROOFS.description: Chain binding proofs linking blockchain keys to the same HD wallet

ENTITY_TYPE.description: Type of entity represented by this profile

SIGNATURE_ALGORITHM.description:
Signature algorithm that produced SIGNATURE (e.g., "ed25519",
"secp256k1"). ABSENT means ed25519 — this single default is what keeps
every EPM signed before this field existed verifying unchanged, so the
field MUST NOT be made required. The signing key is the first CryptoKey
in KEYS with KEY_TYPE Signing whose ALGORITHM matches this declaration
(an absent CryptoKey.ALGORITHM likewise means ed25519)

DOMAIN_PROOFS.description:
DNS domain binding proofs linking domains to the same HD wallet —
symmetric with CHAIN_PROOFS

PHOTO.description:
Photo or logo of the entity (the vCard PHOTO property), as an RFC 2397
data URI carrying a JPEG or PNG image, e.g.
"data:image/jpeg;base64,/9j/4AAQ…". Every peer that resolves the entity
fetches the record, so a producer keeps the image small (a few tens of
kilobytes at most). Signed like every other content field: it
participates in the canonical preimage (CANONICAL_SERIALIZATION.md)

REFERENCE_FRAME.description: Reference Frame in which the object position is defined

AREA_SRP.description: Area of the object solar radiation pressure

X.description: X-coordinate of the object's position in RTN coordinates

Y.description: Y-coordinate of the object's position in RTN

Z.description: Z-coordinate of the object's position in RTN

X_DOT.description: X-coordinate of the object's position in RTN coordinates

Y_DOT.description: Y-coordinate of the object's position in RTN

Z_DOT.description: Z-coordinate of the object's position in RTN

COVARIANCE.description:
Covariance matrix as flat array (9x9 lower triangular = 45 elements).
Order: [CR_R, CT_R, CT_T, CN_R, CN_T, CN_N, CRDOT_R, CRDOT_T, CRDOT_N, CRDOT_RDOT,
CTDOT_R, CTDOT_T, CTDOT_N, CTDOT_RDOT, CTDOT_TDOT,
CNDOT_R, CNDOT_T, CNDOT_N, CNDOT_RDOT, CNDOT_TDOT, CNDOT_NDOT,
CDRG_R, CDRG_T, CDRG_N, CDRG_RDOT, CDRG_TDOT, CDRG_NDOT, CDRG_DRG,
CSRP_R, CSRP_T, CSRP_N, CSRP_RDOT, CSRP_TDOT, CSRP_NDOT, CSRP_DRG, CSRP_SRP,
CTHR_R, CTHR_T, CTHR_N, CTHR_RDOT, CTHR_TDOT, CTHR_NDOT, CTHR_DRG, CTHR_SRP, CTHR_THR]

OBJECT_DESIGNATOR.description:
OBJECT_DESIGNATOR (CCSDS 508.0-B-1): the object's identifier in CATALOG_NAME,
as written. A numeric designator is also OBJECT.NORAD_CAT_ID.

CATALOG_NAME.description: CATALOG_NAME (CCSDS 508.0-B-1): the satellite catalog OBJECT_DESIGNATOR is in.

MANEUVERABLE.description:
MANEUVERABLE (CCSDS 508.0-B-1): YES, NO or N/A. OBJECT.MANEUVERABLE holds the
same fact as a flag, true for YES.

CD_AREA_OVER_MASS.description: CD_AREA_OVER_MASS (CCSDS 508.0-B-1): drag area over mass, m**2/kg.

CDM.description:
Conjunction Data Message

Units of the record: lengths in km (MISS_DISTANCE, RELATIVE_POSITION_*,
SCREEN_VOLUME_*, X, Y, Z), speeds in km/s, and the 6x6 position/velocity part
of each object's COVARIANCE (the first 21 cells) in km**2, km**2/s and
km**2/s**2. The message text states metres: CCSDS 508.0-B-1 gives
MISS_DISTANCE = 715 [m], which this record holds as 0.715. The cells of
COVARIANCE beyond the first 21 (the drag, solar radiation pressure and thrust
terms) are held as the message states them.

CCSDS_CDM_VERS.description: The version of the CCSDS CDM standard used

CREATION_DATE.description: The date the CDM message was created

ORIGINATOR.description: The originator of the CDM message

MESSAGE_FOR.description: The intended recipient of the CDM message

MESSAGE_ID.description: A unique identifier for the CDM message

MISS_DISTANCE.description: The miss distance between the two objects

RELATIVE_SPEED.description: The relative speed between the two objects

START_SCREEN_PERIOD.description: The start time of the screening period

STOP_SCREEN_PERIOD.description: The end time of the screening period

SCREEN_VOLUME_FRAME.description: The reference frame for the screening volume

SCREEN_VOLUME_SHAPE.description: The shape of the screening volume

SCREEN_VOLUME_X.description: The X dimension of the screening volume

SCREEN_VOLUME_Y.description: The Y dimension of the screening volume

SCREEN_VOLUME_Z.description: The Z dimension of the screening volume

SCREEN_ENTRY_TIME.description: The time the objects entered the screening volume

SCREEN_EXIT_TIME.description: The time the objects exited the screening volume

COLLISION_PROBABILITY.description: The probability of collision between the two objects

COLLISION_PROBABILITY_METHOD.description: The method used to calculate the collision probability

OBJECT1.description: The first object in the CDM message

OBJECT2.description: The second object in the CDM message

OBJECT1_DATASOURCE.description: Data Source for the positional information for Object 1

OBJECT2_DATASOURCE.description: Data Source for the positional information for Object 2

COMMENT.description:
COMMENT lines of the message header and of its relative metadata and data
(CCSDS 508.0-B-1), in message order, joined by a line feed.

OBJECT_1.description: Satellite name for the first object

DSE_1.description: Days since epoch for the first object

OBJECT_2.description: Satellite name for the second object

DSE_2.description: Days since epoch for the second object

TCA.description: Time of closest approach as a Unix timestamp

TCA_RANGE.description: The distance or range between the two objects at TCA

TCA_RELATIVE_SPEED.description: The magnitude of the relative velocity at TCA

DILUTION.description: Standard deviation that produces the maximum probability

CQRSourceProvenance.description: Host-resolved provenance. Strings are evidence, not commands to execute.

CQRObjectSource.description:
Exactly one scientific source arm, or a validated instance/source handle.
OMM/TLE use their native mean-element units; OEM/PPE km and km/s; OCM its
declared units. No implicit conversion of TEME, ECEF or ICRF-labelled data.

PROPAGATOR_PORT_ID.description: Host-connected provider for mean elements; no embedded fixed SGP4 choice.

SOURCE_EPOCH.description:
Optional source epoch and perigee/apogee altitude above the reference
Earth radius used by the source model, in SI metres (not geocentric radii).

HAS_PERIGEE_ALTITUDE_M.description: True when PERIGEE_ALTITUDE_M carries a value; false means absent.

HAS_APOGEE_ALTITUDE_M.description: True when APOGEE_ALTITUDE_M carries a value; false means absent.

HARD_BODY_RADIUS_M.description: Hard-body radius in metres given with the source.

HAS_HARD_BODY_RADIUS_M.description: True when HARD_BODY_RADIUS_M carries a value; false means absent.

CATALOG_ENTRY.description:
The object's catalog entry. Without a supplied radius, its SIZE, else
its RCS, gives the hard-body radius (see cqrHardBodyRadiusBasis).

CQRScreeningControls.description: Explicit UTC search window and positive resolution, SI seconds/metres.

PROGRESS_INTERVAL_SECONDS.description: Optional progress cadence; PIV carries backpressure, not scientific data.

HAS_PROGRESS_INTERVAL_SECONDS.description: True when PROGRESS_INTERVAL_SECONDS carries a value; false means absent.

SCREENING.description:
SPHERICAL uses THRESHOLD_M; other geometries use positive finite axes below.
Admit local minima of relative distance inside or on the selected volume.

RADIAL_M.description: RTN ellipsoid semi-axes or box half-widths, metres; ignored for SPHERICAL.

VOLUME_CENTER.description:
PRIMARY or SECONDARY selects that object's centre and RTN at each epoch:
R = unit(r), N = unit(r cross v), T = N cross R in EVALUATION_FRAME.
BOTH tests each object's volume independently and admits their union.
UNSPECIFIED is invalid; degenerate RTN axes are an error for non-spheres.

CQRPairRequest.description:
CONTROLS.COMBINED_RADIUS_M must equal PRIMARY_RADIUS_M + SECONDARY_RADIUS_M.
Reject inconsistent radii instead of silently choosing one source.

EVALUATION_FRAME.description: Common inertial frame used for relative state and encounter-plane geometry.

CQRPlaneGeometry.description:
All numerical fields in metres or square metres in one orthonormal plane.
Xi/zeta axes are normal to relative velocity. Rotate displacement and
covariance together when changing basis; covariance is finite symmetric
positive semidefinite. Probability algorithms requiring an inverse reject
singular covariance unless their documented method supports it.

CQRProbabilityResult.description:
Report the actual algorithm and uncertainty origin. With
MAXIMUM_PROBABILITY_ONLY, MAXIMUM_PROBABILITY is present and PROBABILITY is
inapplicable: consumers must ignore its default zero. Never report a heuristic
maximum as probability computed from supplied covariance. Otherwise
PROBABILITY is unitless in [0,1]; supplied/synthesized covariance is explicit.

HAS_MAXIMUM_PROBABILITY.description: True when MAXIMUM_PROBABILITY carries a value; false means absent.

MAHALANOBIS_SQUARED.description: Explicitly squared distance d^T C^-1 d, dimensionless.

HAS_MAHALANOBIS_SQUARED.description: True when MAHALANOBIS_SQUARED carries a value; false means absent.

CALIBRATION.description:
For a covariance-based probability: whether the covariance's coverage was
measured against independent reference states. Only CALIBRATED
covariance supports a probability beyond "conditional on the stated
assumptions".

CALIBRATION_REFERENCE.description: Identifier of the calibration evidence (a report or record).

CROSS_CORRELATION.description: The correlation assumed between the two objects' errors.

CQRNativeDocument.description:
Typed replacement of a bare raw-text port. Content is UTF-8 with no BOM;
XML declaration, if present, must agree. Content must be nonempty CDM KVN
or CDM XML matching SERIALIZATION; reject UNSPECIFIED and other documents.
Not an arbitrary JSON container.

CQRCatalogRequest.description:
Order arrays index the supplied catalog stream in exact reception order.
Ranges are half-open; absent endpoints select the full respective range.

HAS_START_ORDER_INDEX.description: True when START_ORDER_INDEX carries a value; false means absent.

HAS_END_ORDER_INDEX.description: True when END_ORDER_INDEX carries a value; false means absent.

HAS_SECONDARY_START_ORDER_INDEX.description: True when SECONDARY_START_ORDER_INDEX carries a value; false means absent.

HAS_SECONDARY_END_ORDER_INDEX.description: True when SECONDARY_END_ORDER_INDEX carries a value; false means absent.

CQREvent.description: Explicit summary when legacy source lacks sufficient data for a full CDM.

HAS_DILUTION_THRESHOLD_M.description: True when DILUTION_THRESHOLD_M carries a value; false means absent.

RELATIVE_POSITION_RTN.description: Primary-object RTN components in m and m/s; omitted when unavailable.

PRIMARY_SIGMA_RTN_M.description: One-sigma RTN values in metres, not covariance matrices.

HAS_PRIMARY_DAYS_SINCE_EPOCH.description: True when PRIMARY_DAYS_SINCE_EPOCH carries a value; false means absent.

HAS_SECONDARY_DAYS_SINCE_EPOCH.description: True when SECONDARY_DAYS_SINCE_EPOCH carries a value; false means absent.

CONJUNCTION_MESSAGE.description: Full standards-backed result when physically available.

HAS_MAHALANOBIS_3D_SQUARED.description: True when MAHALANOBIS_3D_SQUARED carries a value; false means absent.

HAS_COMBINED_RADIUS_M.description: True when COMBINED_RADIUS_M carries a value; false means absent.

PRIMARY_HARD_BODY_RADIUS_M.description:
Each object's hard-body radius in metres and where it came from;
COMBINED_RADIUS_M is their sum.

HAS_PRIMARY_HARD_BODY_RADIUS_M.description: True when PRIMARY_HARD_BODY_RADIUS_M carries a value; false means absent.

HAS_SECONDARY_HARD_BODY_RADIUS_M.description: True when SECONDARY_HARD_BODY_RADIUS_M carries a value; false means absent.

PRIMARY_COVARIANCE_BASIS.description:
Where each object's position covariance came from; NONE means the event
carries no covariance-based quantity for it.

SCREENING.description: Geometry used by the screening request that admitted this event.

ADMITTED_BY.description:
Volume(s) containing the other object at TCA; BOTH means both tests passed.
UNSPECIFIED means admission provenance was not reported.

CQRCatalogResult.description:
Stable order by TCA then primary/secondary identity; ties retain original
input-pair order. EVENT_OFFSET indexes this order across bounded chunks.
PIV output cap, YIELDED and BACKLOG_REMAINING carry stream backpressure.

CQRIndexRequest.description:
Resident index construction reuses canonical sources, samples and PPE.
SAMPLED_STATES consumes sampled OEM records in SOURCES[].EPHEMERIS;
POLYNOMIAL_SEGMENTS consumes SEGMENTS/PPE. Handles are validated against
INSTANCE identity/generation; they are never persisted process addresses.

CQRLaunchCriterion.description:
Screening criterion for one object class. Exactly one kind per entry;
SCREENING selects which fields apply.

CQRLaunchSegment.description: One launched object: its trajectory for a liftoff at NOMINAL_LIFTOFF.

TRAJECTORY.description: Sampled states in EVALUATION_FRAME, km and km/s as the OEM defines.

HAS_RADAR_CROSS_SECTION_M2.description: True when RADAR_CROSS_SECTION_M2 carries a value; false means absent.

VALID_FROM.description:
Liftoff times this trajectory applies to, half-open [VALID_FROM,
VALID_UNTIL). Absent bounds select the whole window. Windows whose
trajectory changes (for example a varying azimuth) supply one segment
per span.

CQRLaunchObject.description: One orbiting object to screen against.

SOURCE.description: Ephemeris in EVALUATION_FRAME covering the screened absolute times.

RENDEZVOUS_COORDINATED.description:
A pre-coordinated rendezvous or close approach: reported, never a
window closure.

NOMINAL_LIFTOFF.description: Liftoff time the segment trajectories were produced for.

WINDOW_OPEN.description: Liftoff window, inclusive of both ends.

LIFTOFF_STEP_SECONDS.description: Spacing of evaluated liftoff times, seconds.

CRITERIA.description: One criterion per object class present in OBJECTS.

MINIMUM_ALTITUDE_M.description:
Segment states below this height above the reference ellipsoid are not
screened, metres.

SCREEN_SECONDS_AFTER_LIFTOFF.description:
Screening ends this long after liftoff, seconds, or earlier where a
trajectory ends.

CLOSURE_PAD_SECONDS.description:
Time added before and after every closure for vehicle performance and
timing uncertainty, seconds.

REPORT_RATIO.description:
Report approaches whose criterion ratio is below this value; 1 reports
violations only.

EVALUATION_FRAME.description: Earth-fixed frame shared by every trajectory and ephemeris.

CQRLaunchClosure.description:
Liftoff times that violate at least one criterion, half-open [START, END),
widened by the liftoff step and CLOSURE_PAD_SECONDS and merged.

OBJECT_IDS.description: Orbiting objects that cause this closure.

CQRLaunchApproach.description:
Closest approach of one segment to one orbiting object for one liftoff
time: the worst liftoff time of each contiguous run below REPORT_RATIO.

RELATIVE_POSITION_RTN.description:
Segment position relative to the orbiting object in the object's
radial/in-track/cross-track frame, metres.

CRITERION_RATIO.description:
Normalised separation: distance over radius (SPHERICAL) or ellipsoid
radius (ELLIPSOIDAL). Below 1 violates.

RUN_START.description: First and last liftoff times of the run this approach represents.

APPROACHES.description: Ordered by LIFTOFF, then segment and object identity.

CQR.description:
Conjunction Query and Result — pair/catalog screening, encounter-plane
probability, typed native documents, resident screening-index control and
launch-window screening.
Exactly one arm per PIV payload, selected by the declared METHOD_ID.

LAUNCH_REQUEST.description: APPENDED. Launch-window screening request and result.
